fusions.name: Lazy Wake
fusions.desc: Pushes a heavy wake ahead of you in a cone, dealing 11 damage to everything caught in it and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Slow Roll Into Them
fusions.desc: Rolls a great slow swell at the first enemy in its path, dealing 30 damage. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Time Enough to Spare
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 4 tiles in place for 3 seconds. You move 30% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Drifting Mend
fusions.desc: Each time you cover a long stretch of ground, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
